name: geo_equilateral_iff_sum_sq
informal: A triangle abc in the complex plane is equilateral (possibly degenerate to a point) iff a² + b² + c² = ab + bc + ca — the difference factors as (a + ωb + ω²c)(a + ω²b + ωc) with ω a primitive cube root of unity; a + ωb + ω²c = 0 says c − a is b − a rotated by 60°, and conversely equal side lengths force (c−a)/(b−a) to be a primitive 6th root of unity.
